title: tome.mod.json
description: A Tome mod's metadata (sdk/docs/tome-mod-json.md). Tome checks the file itself when it loads the mod; this schema is for editors.

$schema.description: This schema, for editors. Tome ignores it.

id.description: Unique and stable forever: 2-64 characters, a lowercase letter first, then lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_'.

name.description: Shown in the mod menu; defaults to the id.

icon.description: A .blp or .tga in the mod folder, shown in the mod list.

links.description: Reserved (homepage, source, issues); not shown yet.

game.description: Supported game builds: a range such as "1.27b", ">=1.26a <1.29" or "*". Aliases: 1.24e, 1.26a, 1.27a, 1.27b.

edition.description: The one game the mod is for: "roc" (Reign of Chaos) or "tft" (The Frozen Throne). Leave it out for both.

tome.description: Supported Tome versions: a semver range such as ">=0.1.0 <0.2.0".

depends.description: Must be installed and enabled first: { "id": "range" }.

recommends.description: Mentioned in the mod's warnings when missing.

breaks.description: Can't run together: one of the two stays off.

entry.description: The DLL (32-bit), relative to the mod folder; or { "game range": "path" } checked in order. Leave out for a mod without code.

wasm.description: A WebAssembly module run sandboxed, relative to the mod folder; instead of "entry". Experimental.

assets.description: Folder merged into the game's files; "assets" by default.

mappings.description: Folder of the mod's own mapping files, one per build (<build>.json, e.g. 1.27b.json); its symbols go by "<mod id>/<name>". "mappings" by default.

requires.description: What the mod can't work without: mapped names ("CTextFrame::SetText"), names from a mod's own mapping file ("mymod/CUnit::Foo") and game object properties ("property:mana"). Tome won't load it on builds that lack one.

natives.description: JASS declarations of the natives the mod provides, as a map declares them: "native Foo takes integer x returns nothing".

provides.description: Other ids this mod stands in for in other mods' "depends".

sync.description: client: only this player needs it. required: every player in a multiplayer game needs the same version (checked in the lobby).

reload.description: When changes to the mod's assets apply: right away (live, the default), at the next map load, or after a restart.

load.description: Load order among mods that don't depend on each other.

config.description: The settings schema (sdk/schemas/config.schema.schema.json); Tome makes the mod's settings page from it.

label.description: Shown on the Keybinds page; defaults to the id.

default.description: Modifiers (Ctrl, Shift, Alt) and a key joined with '+': "Ctrl+H", "F5", "Ctrl+Shift+Num1", or "None".

path.description: A path inside the mod folder.
